params.name: max_length
params.description: Maximum length, in characters, of the returned fact.

items.docs: Returns a single random cat fact. An optional max_length query parameter caps the returned fact length, which is useful for SMS, push notifications, and any other length-constrained surface.

params.name: max_length
params.description: Maximum length, in characters, of each returned fact.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of facts to return per page.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of cat facts. Supports max_length (character cap per fact) and limit (page size) query parameters. The response follows Laravel's paginator format with current_page, per_page, total, last_page, links, and a data array of CatFact objects.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of breeds to return per page.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of cat breeds with country, origin, coat, and pattern attributes. Supports a limit query parameter for page size. The response follows Laravel's paginator format with current_page, per_page, total, last_page, links, and a data array of Breed objects.
